sheet.title: Fox and Moon Puppet
sheet.heading: The fox, rebuilt as a real puppet
sheet.lede: Six takes from your reference: the fox as a high-resolution paper puppet. This round decides who he is. The pieces the film is animated from come next, made as edits of the take you pick, so he stays one fox.

detail.caption: Your reference's fox head at its real size: about 90 pixels across, enlarged. This is what the old version was cut from.
The same head in take A1 at its real size: about 690 pixels across in the source, with the paper, the ear tips and the eye intact.

notes: These are on plain grey card under even light on purpose: the moon's light, the night colour and the shadows are added when the pieces are composited, as a puppet is lit on the set. The colour will be graded to your reference's darker, earthier orange.
The reviewers' pick is A1: its face, long muzzle, dark almond eye and charcoal-backed ears are closest to your panels 2 and 4.

A2 is the same puppet; its lying pose stretches both forelegs out oddly. B1 and B2 lay the puppet out in pieces, but their heads have a realistic amber eye, a smile and painted eyelets, so they are a guide to the cut, not the source.
C1 and C2 have the most puppet-like poses and paper, but each fox is small in the frame (a head of about 120 pixels), and their fur is cut like feathers. They guide the poses only.
Your reference's fox faces right; these face left. That is free to fix: the pieces are lit flat and the pins are added afterwards, so they flip.
Next, before anything is rigged: one still of him at the touch, composited into the moonlit pond, for you to set beside your panel 5.

takeNotes.k1-sheet-nb-1: A1: four poses; the face, eye and ears closest to your reference. The reviewers' pick.
takeNotes.k1-sheet-nb-2: A2: the same puppet; the lying pose stretches both forelegs forward.
takeNotes.k1-parts-nb-1: B1: the pieces laid out loose. A realistic amber eye; extra legs and paws; a guide to the cut only.
takeNotes.k1-parts-nb-2: B2: the pieces close to assembled; the cleanest breakdown, but the amber eye and a slight smile.
takeNotes.k1-sheet-gpt-1: C1: the most puppet-like poses (your panels 1, 2, 3 and 5), many pins, feather-cut fur, small in frame.
takeNotes.k1-sheet-gpt-2: C2: as C1, a little darker.

k1.reviews: Creative director: A1 is him (face, muzzle, dark almond eye, charcoal-backed ears); B's amber eye, smile and eyelets and C's feather fur and 7-10 pins drift. Technical artist: no take can be cut into a rig (pieces painted over each other, mixed pin hardware, flat-topped joints, baked light, half the pixels are real detail). Skeptic: so the pieces are made as pose families, each an edit of the picked sheet, cut into about six layers. See docs/reviews/2026-10-fable.md.
